--- /linux/reproduce_issue.c
+++ /linux/reproduce_issue.c
@@ -1,0 +2,49 @@
+#define _GNU_SOURCE
+#include <endian.h>
+#include <fcntl.h>
+#include <stdint.h>
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <stdlib.h>
+#include <string.h>
+#include <sys/stat.h>
+#include <sys/syscall.h>
+#include <sys/types.h>
+#include <unistd.h>
+
+#ifndef __NR_mkdirat
+#define __NR_mkdirat 258
+#endif
+#ifndef __NR_openat
+#define __NR_openat 257
+#endif
+#ifndef __NR_write
+#define __NR_write 1
+#endif
+
+int main(void)
+{
+    syscall(__NR_mkdirat, -100, "./cgroup/syz0", 0x1ff);
+    long r0 = syscall(__NR_openat, -100, "./cgroup", 0x200002, 0);
+    // Note: syzkaller usually mounts cgroup2 at ./cgroup.
+    // The reproducer assumes a cgroup mount.
+    // However, in this environment, we might not have cgroup mounted there.
+    // The reproducer snippet:
+    // mkdirat$cgroup_root(0xffffffffffffff9c, &(0x7f0000000000)='./cgroup/syz0\x00', 0x1ff)
+    // r0 = openat$cgroup_root(0xffffffffffffff9c, &(0x7f0000000000), 0x200002, 0x0)
+    // r1 = openat$cgroup_ro(r0, &(0x7f0000000040)='cgroup.freeze\x00', 0x275a, 0x0)
+    // write$cgroup_int(r1, &(0x7f0000000200)=0x1, 0x12)
+
+    // Adapted C code:
+    // We assume cgroup2 is mounted at /sys/fs/cgroup or we need to mount it.
+    // But verify if we can run this inside the VM setup by run_kernel.
+
+    // Since I cannot run the reproducer LOCALLY (as per instructions),
+    // I will just prepare the patch and rely on /KBDr/run_kernel which runs the syzbot reproducer presumably.
+    // Wait, "It is important NOT TO run your own validation ... run run_kernel script ... to get feedback."
+
+    // So I don't need to write a reproduction C file myself to run locally.
+    // I just need to apply the fix.
+
+    return 0;
+}
+
